reason: org.apache.cxf:cxf-rt-rs-security-oauth2 is resolved at version 4.2.2, which is affected; the remediating version 4.2.2.vendor-00001 exists. The vulnerable class DefaultEncryptingCodeDataProvider is never referenced in the application source, so the upgrade is not urgent.

vulnerability.summary: Apache CXF: DefaultEncryptingCodeDataProvider allows unlimited authorization code replay

reachability.evidence: Searched all five application source files (HelloWorldApplication.java, HelloWorldResource.java, OAuth2Config.java, SampleBearerTokenValidator.java, HelloWorldResourceTest.java). Neither DefaultEncryptingCodeDataProvider nor removeCodeGrant appears in any of them. The application uses OAuthRequestFilter with a custom SampleBearerTokenValidator for bearer-token validation only; the authorization-code grant flow backed by DefaultEncryptingCodeDataProvider is not used.
